create_HFLlamaPredictorConfig: create an HFLlamaPredictorConfig dataclass with an optional system_prompt for Llama model generation
build_HFLlamaPredictor_from_config: build an HFLlamaPredictor instance from an HFLlamaPredictorConfig using the from_config static method
run_HFLlamaPredictor_call: run the HFLlamaPredictor call method to generate text predictions from a list of prompts
apply_chat_template_HFLlamaPredictor: apply the Llama chat template to prompts with optional system message and max length
review_HFLlamaPredictor_stop_tokens: review the HFLlamaPredictor stop token IDs configuration for EOS and EOT tokens
